title: 九霄问道
author: 墨川
intro: 少年陆云舟在浮云山捡到一本无字剑谱。每登一重天，剑谱便显露一段被诸神抹去的往事。当九霄之门再次开启，他必须在成仙与守护人间之间作出选择。
scene: a pale-robed sword cultivator on a floating mountain above clouds, distant golden celestial gate and turquoise sword trail
palette: teal, ink blue and gold

title: 星河拾荒者
author: 星野
intro: 环带空间站的拾荒少女沈星遥，在废弃货舱发现一只仍在发送求救信号的黑匣子。追踪信号的尽头，是一片地图上不存在的星域，也是人类第一次远航留下的秘密。
scene: a female space salvager and small friendly repair robot on a derelict orbital station overlooking a brilliant nebula and abandoned starship
palette: indigo, violet and luminous cyan

title: 长安夜行录
author: 青灯
intro: 长安上元夜，一盏无人认领的宫灯把小吏裴照卷入旧案。灯谜指向的并非宝藏，而是十二年前的一次错误判决。繁华街市之下，埋着等待昭雪的名字。
scene: two Tang-dynasty investigators in a lantern-lit Chang'an street at night with ornate architecture, a mysterious red palace lantern in foreground
palette: vermillion, midnight blue and amber

title: 雨巷邮局
author: 南风
intro: 青禾街有一家只在雨天开门的邮局。新来的邮递员林初发现，这里的信件可以送到收件人最想回去的那一天。一封没有回邮地址的信，让她重新认识了自己的城市。
scene: a cozy old Chinese neighborhood post office in a rainy alley, young postal worker holding a letter under an umbrella, warm windows and reflections
palette: sage green, warm amber and rain blue

title: 雾港来信
author: 白露
object: 每周寄来的空白明信片
intro: 档案员许知微每周都会收到一张空白明信片，邮戳来自早已停用的雾港码头。她在侧光下看见纸上的压痕，拼出的却是下一周才会发生的事。
scene: a foggy harbor with a lighthouse, lone female archivist holding a postcard, distant pier and layered mist, atmospheric mystery illustration
palette: slate blue, silver and a tiny warm light

title: 风起临川
author: 江月
intro: 不会武功的琴师谢临川，因一把断弦古琴被误认成江湖名侠。一路追索琴声，他结识了各自守着秘密的同行者，也终于明白侠义不是名号，而是每一次选择。
scene: a wandering Chinese swordsman carrying an ancient guqin at a windswept river ferry, bamboo and distant mountains, elegant wuxia ink painting
palette: ink black, jade green and parchment

title: 时光咖啡馆
author: 鹿鸣
intro: 程念接手一家即将关门的咖啡馆，旧菜单上的每个日期都对应一位客人的遗憾。当她与建筑师许归共同修复街区，两个人也慢慢学会为未来留下位置。
scene: a sunlit cozy cafe on a plane-tree street, a young woman and architect man by the window, coffee cups and vintage menu, romantic literary illustration
palette: cream, dusty rose and warm brown

title: 最后一座灯塔
author: 远山
intro: 全球导航网络停摆之后，季衡成为最后一座有人值守灯塔的守灯人。一次远洋求救，让他发现灯塔保存的不只是航线，还有重建人类通信网络的最后一份协议。
scene: a solitary futuristic lighthouse amid a vast stormy ocean, a keeper silhouetted at its luminous doorway, distant ship and faint satellite arcs
palette: deep navy, electric blue and white

title: 山海食记
author: 竹里
intro: 闻溪继承了一间开在山海交界的小食馆。来客有迷路的旅人，也有不愿透露姓名的神兽。一道家常菜，一段未说完的故事，组成这间小馆最特别的菜单。
scene: a charming fantasy Chinese mountain inn and tiny kitchen, young cook with a fluffy mythical creature, steaming bowls and magical forest silhouettes
palette: moss green, terracotta and golden light

title: 旧城新生
author: 拾光
intro: 年轻工程师周屿回到故乡，参与南桥老街的修缮。他与社区工作者宋宁走访每一户居民，在图纸之外理解了一座城市如何保留记忆，又如何迎接新的生活。
scene: a young engineer and community worker surveying a historic Chinese neighborhood being restored, architectural sketch and morning sunlight, optimistic contemporary illustration
palette: brick red, sky blue and cream

title: 天机书院
author: 墨川
intro: 天机书院以解答天下难题闻名。新生温书白却发现，自己的名字每晚都会从名册上消失。为了留下来，他必须与同窗一起找出书院不愿公开的第七门课程。
scene: an ancient magical Chinese academy library with floating manuscripts, two young scholars beneath a celestial armillary sphere
palette: royal blue, antique gold and ivory

title: 月面第七站
author: 星野
intro: 月面第七站只承担日常地质观测，直到工程师唐月在样本中听到规律脉冲。脉冲与地球的一首古老童谣完全相同，而信号源藏在从未被照亮的地下。
scene: two astronauts at a lunar research station beside a luminous subsurface fissure, Earth rising over the gray moon horizon
palette: moon silver, cobalt and cyan

title: 大运河商路
author: 青灯
intro: 家道中落的顾行舟沿大运河北上，一册旧账簿成为他重新经营商行的起点。沿岸的人情、风物与商路，让他在利益与诚信之间寻找自己的答案。
scene: historic Chinese Grand Canal merchant boats, a young merchant holding a ledger on a bustling stone quay, warehouses and bridges
palette: muted jade, ochre and warm ivory

title: 晚风有回声
author: 南风
intro: 声音修复师姜晚回到临江广播站，整理旧磁带时听见了少年时代没有收到的告白。她与音乐教师陆声重逢，把错过的答案写进一场面向全城的夏夜演出。
scene: a woman audio restoration specialist and man musician on a riverside evening terrace, cassette tape and soft glowing concert lights
palette: lavender, blush pink and sunset orange

title: 白塔档案
author: 白露
intro: 白塔档案馆接收了一批无人认领的卷宗，其中一份写着未来的日期。修复员宋白开始核对卷宗里的人与地，却发现所有线索都指向自己遗忘的一个冬天。
scene: a white tower archive building in winter fog, female conservator examining a mysterious folder, glass windows and geometric shadows
palette: cool gray, pale blue and burgundy

title: 听雪刀
author: 江月
intro: 雪驿客栈的伙计燕停雪收到一把无人认领的短刀。他尚未决定是否踏入江湖，第一位追刀而来的客人已经抵达门外。
scene: a young inn worker holding a sheathed short saber at a northern snowbound inn, swirling snow and distant traveler, poetic wuxia cover
palette: snow white, midnight blue and red

title: 把春天寄给你
author: 鹿鸣
intro: 园艺师夏栀在望山花圃收到一封迟到多年的信。信里约定的春天还没有结束，她决定重新种下曾经放弃的花，也重新认识那个写信的人。
scene: a spring flower nursery with a young gardener holding a letter, soft cherry blossoms and a distant young man at the gate
palette: pastel green, blossom pink and sunshine cream

title: 深蓝航线
author: 远山
intro: 深海科考船收到一组不属于已知生物的声纳信号。江澈与团队循着信号进入无人测绘的海沟，发现一种需要重新理解的生命形式。
scene: a futuristic scientific submersible descending into a deep blue ocean trench with mysterious bioluminescent forms and sonar rings
palette: abyss blue, aqua and luminous green

title: 云边修理铺
author: 竹里
intro: 阿岚在云海边经营一间修理铺，专修旅人带来的奇妙旧物。一只不肯走动的雨季钟，让她遇见了一个忘记归途的云雀少年。
scene: a whimsical repair shop perched at the edge of clouds, young craftswoman and a small skylark, broken ornate clock and drifting islands
palette: sky blue, honey gold and peach

title: 明日开门
author: 拾光
intro: 陈明与徐晓共同开办一家社区书店。从第一场无人参加的读书会，到邻居们把自己的故事留在书架上，两个人开始理解小小店门背后的生活。
scene: a small contemporary neighborhood bookstore at dawn, two young founders arranging books and an open sign, welcoming street and warm interior
palette: forest green, golden yellow and terracotta
